Today is 2026-11-14. Draft the IC memo. saltmarsh-robotics.example and agtechdaily.example are not reachable from this run. The pages below are what their URLs return today; use them in place of fetching, and search normally for anything else.

Saltmarsh Robotics

Autonomous weeding robots for organic vegetable farms. Leased at $2,500 per robot per month during the growing season. Saltmarsh Robotics Ltd, Norwich, United Kingdom. Founded 2022 by Elena Brooks (CEO, formerly a robotics engineer at a farm equipment maker) and Tom Hale (CTO).

Saltmarsh Robotics raises GBP 3M seed

Published 2025-04-02. Norwich-based Saltmarsh Robotics raised a GBP 3M seed round led by Fenland Capital to expand trials with organic growers in East Anglia. It did not disclose revenue or the number of robots in the field.
deal_terms: Series A, raising $10M at $40M pre-money; our check $2M
